acceptance: marginal contribution over the family coverage pool (not over the four holdout episodes), with ordering coverage in the criterion
ordering_gate: on -- an episode is unsolved unless its required ordering is emitted

columns.heldout_X: union of the other 13, one cell per fold family
columns.comp(all): union of all 14 -- the same artefact as the ID column

why_all_families: the baselines build from the whole induction half (viki_eval_memento.py:93 uses episodes[::2] of train.parquet, exclude_family only for folds; the G-Memory and RAG arms read the same file), so a subset would compare a method shown less data against arms shown all of it
union_rule: Layer 1 deduplicated by effect schema and body signature, provenance merged, support recomputed on the union's episode pool; Layer 2 and Layer 3 are NOT unioned -- they are re-mined on that column's pool
